dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Large, irregular looping bands with crenulated perimeters; high-contrast transition from dark-grey background to off-white interior outlines forming prominent closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density; markings are primarily linear/annular rather than punctate, though sparse low-intensity pixel clusters are embedded within the wider light-colored bands.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-lateral loops form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary axis oriented longitudinally along the body curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, high-contrast wide band encircles the posterior-midsection, creating a distinct ribbon-like topological feature.
